## SF Login API — Background_Community

This request fetches records from the **Background_Community** entity using the **SAP SuccessFactors OData v2 API**. It retrieves a paginated list of community background entries associated with employee profiles in the SuccessFactors platform.

---

### Authentication

This request uses **Basic Authentication**. Provide your SuccessFactors username and password in the Authorization header.

| Field    | Value                        |
|----------|------------------------------|
| Type     | Basic Auth                   |
| Username | Your SuccessFactors username |
| Password | Your SuccessFactors password |

---

### Endpoint

```
GET https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/Background_Community
```

---

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Description                                              |
|-----------|---------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `$top`    | integer | No       | Limits the number of records returned. Default is `20`. |

**Example:**
```
?$top=20
```

---

### Example Response

The API returns an **Atom/XML feed** in the following format:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" standalone="yes"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"
      xmlns:m="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ado/2007/08/dataservices/metadata"
      xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ado/2007/08/dataservices"
      xml:base="https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/">
  <title type="text">Background_Community</title>
  <id>https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/Background_Community</id>
  <updated>2026-03-27T12:10:44Z</updated>
  <link rel="self" title="Background_Community" href="Background_Community" />
  <!-- entry elements with community background records -->
</feed>
```

- **Content-Type:** `application/atom+xml`
- **Status Code:** `200 OK` on success

## Generate SAML Assertion

Generates a signed **SAML 2.0 assertion** for use in the SAP SuccessFactors **OAuth 2.0 SAML Bearer flow**. The assertion is cryptographically signed using an RSA private key and is intended to be exchanged for an OAuth access token via the [Generate Access Token](request/52928344-fac8018d-ac0c-4535-9e5f-d7e0e1a6de2b) request.

---

### Endpoint

| Method | URL |
|--------|-----|
| `POST` | `https://api44.sapsf.com/oauth/idp` |

---

### Request Body

Sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `user_id` | `ECAdmin` | The SAP SuccessFactors user ID on whose behalf the SAML assertion is generated. |
| `token_url` | `https://api44.sapsf.com/oauth/token` | The OAuth token endpoint URL referenced within the SAML assertion. |
| `private_key` | `<RSA private key in base64>` | The RSA private key (base64-encoded) used to sign the SAML assertion. |
| `client_id` | `NmEwYWE4MDJmYmVlMjg2NGVhNzhjYzcwOWY2OA` | The OAuth client ID (API key) registered in SAP SuccessFactors. |
| `Content-Type` | `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` | Content type sent as a body parameter. |

---

### Response

**Status:** `200 OK`  
**Format:** XML

Returns a signed **SAML 2.0 assertion** XML document. This assertion must be passed as input to the **Generate Access Token** request to obtain an OAuth bearer token for authenticating subsequent API calls.

---

### Next Step

Use the SAML assertion returned by this request as the `assertion` parameter in the [Generate Access Token](request/52928344-fac8018d-ac0c-4535-9e5f-d7e0e1a6de2b) request to complete the OAuth 2.0 SAML Bearer flow.

## Generate Access Token

Exchanges a SAML 2.0 Bearer Assertion for an OAuth 2.0 access token using the SAP SuccessFactors OAuth token endpoint. This is part of the SAML Bearer Assertion Flow, where a pre-generated SAML assertion is used to authenticate and obtain a short-lived Bearer token for subsequent API calls.

---

### Endpoint

`POST https://api44.sapsf.com/oauth/token`

---

### Request Body

Sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | Yes | The OAuth client (API key) registered in SAP SuccessFactors. |
| `grant_type` | Yes | Must be `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:saml2-bearer` to use the SAML Bearer flow. |
| `company_id` | Yes | The SAP SuccessFactors company/tenant ID (e.g., `packagesli`). |
| `assertion` | Yes | A Base64-encoded, signed SAML 2.0 assertion. This assertion must be generated beforehand (e.g., via the **Generate SAML** request) and is time-limited. |

---

### Response

On success, returns a JSON object with the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `access_token` | string | The Bearer token to use in the `Authorization` header for subsequent API requests. |
| `token_type` | string | Always `Bearer`. |
| `expires_in` | integer | Token validity in seconds from the time of issuance. |

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJ0b2tlbkNvbnRlbnQi...",
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 5958
}
```

---

### Usage

Use the returned `access_token` as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header for all subsequent SAP SuccessFactors API requests:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

---

### Notes

- The SAML assertion (`assertion` field) is time-sensitive and typically valid for only a few minutes. Regenerate it using the **Generate SAML** request if it has expired.
- The `expires_in` value indicates remaining token lifetime in seconds at the time of issuance.
- This endpoint is specific to the `api44` data center. Adjust the subdomain (e.g., `api45`, `api46`) to match your company's assigned SAP SuccessFactors data center.

## Overview

This endpoint retrieves employee job information from the **SAP SuccessFactors OData v2 API** for a specific user. It returns detailed job-related data such as job title, pay grade, business unit, employment status, cost center, and more.

## Endpoint

```
GET https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/EmpJob
```

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|-----------|----------|-------------|
| `$filter` | Yes | Filters results by `userId`. Example: `userId eq '10009700'` |
| `$select` | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Example: `userId,payGrade,jobTitle,businessUnit,company` |
| `$format` | Yes | Response format. Use `json` for JSON output. |

## Key Response Fields

The response is returned under `d.results[]`. Notable fields include:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `userId` | Unique identifier of the employee |
| `jobCode` | Code representing the employee's job role |
| `localJobTitle` | Job title of the employee |
| `payGrade` | Pay grade assigned to the employee |
| `businessUnit` | Business unit the employee belongs to |
| `company` | Company code |
| `emplStatus` | Employment status code |
| `employeeClass` | Classification of the employee |
| `costCenter` | Cost center associated with the employee |
| `location` | Work location code |
| `managerId` | User ID of the employee's manager |
| `startDate` | Job start date (in OData `/Date(milliseconds)/` format) |
| `endDate` | Job end date (in OData `/Date(milliseconds)/` format) |
| `contractType` | Type of employment contract |
| `workscheduleCode` | Work schedule assigned to the employee |
| `countryOfCompany` | Country code of the employing company |

## Authentication

This API requires **OAuth 2.0 Bearer token** authentication. The token must be obtained via the **SAML Bearer assertion flow** and passed in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

## Notes

- Date fields (e.g., `startDate`, `endDate`, `createdDateTime`) are returned in OData `/Date(milliseconds)/` format, where the value represents Unix time in milliseconds. Convert to a readable date as needed.
- Use `$select` to limit the fields returned and reduce response payload size.

## Overview

This endpoint retrieves user profile information from the **SAP SuccessFactors OData v2 API** for a specific employee. It returns personal and employment-related data such as display name, job title, pay grade, hire date, employment status, and other attributes associated with the `User` entity in SAP SuccessFactors.

## Endpoint

```
GET https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/User
```

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|-----------|----------|-------------|
| `$filter` | Yes | Filters results by `userId` and/or `status`. Example: `userId eq '10009673' and status in 't'` |
| `$format` | Yes | Response format. Use `json` for JSON output. |

## Key Response Fields

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `userId` | The unique employee ID in SAP SuccessFactors. |
| `displayName` | The employee's full display name. |
| `firstName` | Employee's first name. |
| `lastName` | Employee's last name. |
| `salutation` | Salutation/title prefix (e.g., `MR`, `MS`). |
| `email` | Employee's work email address. |
| `title` | Job title of the employee. |
| `payGrade` | Pay grade classification assigned to the employee. |
| `employeeClass` | Employment classification (e.g., `Contractual`, `Regular`). |
| `hireDate` | Date the employee was hired, in OData `/Date(milliseconds)/` format. |
| `status` | Employment status code. See **Notes** for possible values. |
| `gender` | Gender of the employee (`M` or `F`). |
| `country` | Country of the employee's work location. |
| `location` | Specific work location or region. |
| `division` | Division the employee belongs to. |
| `timeZone` | Employee's configured time zone (e.g., `Asia/Karachi`). |
| `defaultLocale` | Default locale setting (e.g., `en_US`). |
| `dateOfBirth` | Employee's date of birth, in OData `/Date(milliseconds)/` format. |
| `assignmentUUID` | Unique identifier for the employee's assignment record. |
| `isAlumni` | Boolean indicating whether the employee is an alumni. |
| `username` | Login username, typically the same as `userId`. |

## Authentication

This API requires **OAuth 2.0 Bearer token** authentication. The token must be included in the `Authorization` header of every request:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}
```

Refer to the collection-level authentication configuration for token generation details. Use the **Generate Access Token** request in this collection to obtain a valid token before calling this endpoint.

## Notes

- The `userId` parameter corresponds to the **employee ID** in SAP SuccessFactors. Update the `$filter` value to query a different employee.
- The `status` field uses single-character codes to represent employment status:
  - `'t'` — **Terminated** employees
  - `'a'` — **Active** employees
- Dates (e.g., `hireDate`, `dateOfBirth`, `lastModifiedDateTime`) are returned in OData `/Date(milliseconds+offset)/` format. Convert the millisecond timestamp to a human-readable date as needed.
- This request targets the `api44` instance of SAP SuccessFactors. Ensure the correct instance URL is used for your environment (e.g., `api4`, `api8`, `api44`).
- The response follows the standard OData v2 envelope: `{ "d": { "results": [ ... ] } }`. An empty `results` array indicates no matching records were found for the given filter.

## Get HRBP

Retrieves the HR Business Partner (HRBP) and other job relationship records for a specific user from the SAP SuccessFactors OData v2 API.

### Endpoint

`GET https://api44.sapsf.com/odata/v2/EmpJobRelationships`

### Authentication

Uses Bearer Token authentication. Provide a valid token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `$filter` | `userId eq '10008590'` | Filters job relationship records by the specified user ID. |
| `$format` | `json` | Specifies the response format as JSON. |

### Key Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `userId` | String | The ID of the employee whose relationships are being queried. |
| `relationshipType` | String | The type of relationship. `18570` indicates an **HR Business Partner (HRBP)**. |
| `relUserId` | String | The user ID of the related person — for `relationshipType` `18570`, this is the **HRBP's user ID**. |
| `startDate` | String (Date) | The start date of the relationship (OData date format). |
| `endDate` | String (Date) | The end date of the relationship. |
| `lastModifiedDateTime` | String (Date) | Last modified timestamp with timezone offset. |
| `createdDateTime` | String (Date) | Creation timestamp with timezone offset. |
| `createdBy` | String | User ID of the person who created the record. |
| `lastModifiedBy` | String | User ID of the person who last modified the record. |

### How to Identify the HRBP

Filter the results for the record where `relationshipType` equals `18570`. The `relUserId` field on that record contains the **HRBP's user ID**.

### Example Response

```json
{
  "d": {
    "results": [
      {
        "relationshipType": "18570",
        "userId": "10008590",
        "relUserId": "20003534",
        "startDate": "/Date(1735689600000)/",
        "endDate": "/Date(253402214400000)/",
        "lastModifiedDateTime": "/Date(1769516905000+0000)/",
        "createdDateTime": "/Date(1769516905000+0000)/",
        "createdBy": "10009711",
        "lastModifiedBy": "10009711"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

In this example, the HRBP for user `10008590` is the user with ID `20003534`.
